column1: # Infrastructure signatures for red-triage.sh (CI plan C17, owner decision D5 2026-10-20): a red job whose log matches
# one gets one script-decided rerun of that job. One per line: <id><TAB><extended regex, grep -E>. Add one only for a
# failure of the machine, never of the code under test; a signature that also matches a real test failure would buy
# that failure a rerun. Lines starting with # are comments.
